title: Schema compatibility registry
description: datasets/schema-compatibility.json - shared reader-side compatibility contract for schema versions. Writers remain strict and emit the current schema version; readers and validators accept older versions only when this registry explicitly permits them.

x-changelog.description: Initial registry schema for ADR-0047. Defines default current-only reader policy plus explicit per-surface schema-version overrides for additive minor compatibility. Row C of TODO/20260530-schema-version-compatibility-plan.md adds the contract surface without changing validator or frontend runtime behavior.

surfaceId.description: The reader surface whose compatibility policy is being described. json-corpus covers JSON artifacts in datasets/ and config/. canonical-manifest-reader covers manifest/table schema versions consumed by the frontend canonical-store reader.

pathGlob.description: POSIX-style relative glob naming the artifacts covered by this policy. No drive letters or backslashes.

policy.description: current_schema_only means the current schema x-version is accepted by default. unsupported_unless_listed means no version is accepted unless an overrides[] row names it.

validation.description: Artifacts are validated against the current schema in this registry version. Declared-version validation and retained historical schemas are future Row H work.

accepted_versions.description: Versions accepted by this reader surface for this schema. The current schema version must be included by tests. Old major versions are forbidden until retained schemas, translators, or migrations exist.
